title: Paper call: Five Below 5-year outcome ≥3.0x from 2026-09-30 (decision card v1)
body: Forward test of the decision-card method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell; PRACTICE EXAMPLE built from test inputs). Probability 0.04 (base rate 0.078, class us_ipo_3y_ritter) that: YES if the total-return multiple (adjusted close incl. dividends reinvested, splits/bonuses adjusted) from 2026-09-30 (entry USD 220.00) to the last close on or before 2031-09-30 is ≥ 3.0. Model: worksheet scenarios bear 30%→0.55x, base 47%→1.23x, bull 21%→2.11x with σ=0.35; reverse DCF base-case IRR 7.9%; card rule output: size 0: blocked by Stage 4 soft flags (6 open, no variant view → NO POSITION); Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.19x vs hurdle 1.47x → below hurdle → size 0). Score with Brier vs the base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: US operating-company IPOs 1975-2021, 3-yr buy-and-hold from first close (Ritter Table 16e). IPOs, not seasoned stocks, and 3 years not 5. p_ge_3x = share with BHR > +200% (6.0% + 1.3% + 0.5%). With LTM sales >= $100m the >50% loss share falls to 25.9%. Use only as a rough US left-tail anchor until a seasoned-stock 5-yr distribution is computed.
